tijori.business_description: Pranav Constructions Limited, incorporated in 2003, is a real estate company focused on pure-play redevelopment projects in Mumbai, primarily the Western Suburbs. It undertakes residential redevelopment across Economical, Mid & Mass, and Aspirational housing segments.
